title: Capstone: SVG Drawing Studio
description: Produce real vector images that open in any web browser.
requirements: Each implements `toSvg()` and `clone()`, plus style (fill, stroke, opacity)
Command language: `circle 100 100 40 fill=red`, `group start` … `group end rotate=45`
Generate art: spirals, fractal tree (recursion), a bar chart from data
Stretch: `Visitor` that computes a bounding box without touching shape classes
